title: Feel lab: only what matters in this scene
kaylee: Nothing new for her: your feel lab now shows a handful of sliders for the scene you're in, and you can jump to any game and section from the panel.
questions: The bike shows 8 main sliders and folds the other 12 under More. Is that the right amount?
